dct_description_sm: Inset of Okanagan Band Duck Lake 7 Reserve not georeferenced.

Georeferenced map of reserves of Okanagan Band Duck Lake 7 and West Bank Nation Mission Creek 8 in the central Okanagan Lake area clipped from original Plan of Indian Reserves, Okanagan, Yale District (https://doi.org/10.58066/3hsn-0p20). Land cover and features include roads to Kamloops and Penticton, fields, Mill Creek, Mission Creek, and an R.C. Mission.
